name.zh: 按顺序从公共池选走一个
name.en: Take one option from a shared pool

summary.zh: 自己拿走的东西，也会从别人的选择里消失。
summary.en: Your pick disappears from everyone else’s options.

rules.zh: 所有人面对同一批公开物品，轮到自己时选走一个，再从剩下的内容继续选择。玩家既考虑自身需要，也观察别人最缺什么；先选的优势、后选时的剩余物与补货时机共同改变价值。
rules.en: Players choose from one public pool. A taken item is unavailable to others, so each choice considers personal needs and opponents’ priorities. Pick order, remaining items and replenishment timing change an option’s value.

loop.zh: 比较自己与他人的需要

loop.en: Take one and update the pool

loop.zh: 根据剩余内容调整计划

decisions.zh: 先拿最适合自己的，还是先拿对手只差的那一件？
decisions.en: Take your best fit or deny the one piece an opponent needs?

decisions.zh: 某个普通选项很多，是否可以留到下一次再拿？
decisions.en: Can a common option safely wait until your next pick?

effect.zh: 每人选择后立即补货减弱抢夺，整轮结束才补货强化先后顺序。
effect.en: Immediate replacement softens competition; round-end replacement emphasizes order.

effect.zh: 放置或使用条件会让同一件物品对不同玩家价值不同。
effect.en: Placement or use requirements give the same item different values for different players.

contrast.zh: 璀璨玻璃是逐个回合选骰并立即放置；云顶之弈的共享选秀按释放顺序竞争，价值还包含英雄与装备的组合。
contrast.en: Sagrada resolves individual die-picking turns with immediate placement; TFT’s shared draft uses release order and packages a champion with an item.

combination.zh: 组合提案：战斗奖励改为全队公开轮选，选到的牌进入个人牌组；需要提前判断队友会拿走哪张，保留第二方案。
combination.en: Design proposal: draft battle rewards from a shared pool into personal decks, anticipating which cards teammates take and keeping a backup choice.

setup.zh: 三人面对两把剑和一面盾，你的队伍缺防护，对手也只有攻击装备。
setup.en: Three players see two swords and one shield; you lack defense and an opponent has only weapons.

result.zh: 自己补足防护，对手只能从两把剑中选择。
result.en: You gain protection and the opponent must choose between swords.

next.zh: 下一轮对手可能优先抢防具，你要观察新池再决定。
next.en: The opponent may prioritize defense next round, so inspect the new pool.

firstStep.zh: 用三名本地玩家、六张公开牌与两个不同收集目标做一轮轮选。
firstStep.en: Use three local players, six public cards and two collection goals for one draft.

pitfall.zh: 不要让所有玩家永远按同一张强度表拿牌。
pitfall.en: Avoid a universal ranking that dictates every pick.

test.zh: 玩家是否会查看别人的需求，并因此改变自己的选择？
test.en: Do players change their picks after checking others’ needs?
